detailZones.title: Coffee pot
detailZones.description: The curved glass pot holds dark brewed coffee. Condensation, the liquid surface and a line of bubbles show through the glass.

detailZones.title: Drip coffee maker
detailZones.description: The coffee maker has a broad black top and a brushed steel front above the pot. The coffee outlet sits just above the lid of the pot.

detailZones.title: Warming base and controls
detailZones.description: The pot rests on the dark warming plate. The lower housing has a round power button and a bright strip of steel.

detailZones.title: Roasted beans and jar
detailZones.description: Whole beans fill the lower part of the open jar. Its heavy glass lid swings to the left, and a wire clasp hangs on the right. Loose beans lie in front.

detailZones.title: Hand coffee grinder
detailZones.description: A crank with a wooden grip turns above the open metal hopper. The wooden grinder body has a small pull-out drawer on the front.

detailZones.title: Paper filters and measuring scoop
detailZones.description: Nested fluted filters stand behind a metal scoop heaped with ground coffee. The end of the scoop handle has a hanging hole.

detailZones.title: Mugs, saucer and spoon
detailZones.description: A terracotta-colored mug and a teal mug stand behind an empty saucer. A small metal spoon lies diagonally across the saucer.

detailZones.title: Takeaway cups and stirrers
detailZones.description: Plain paper cups are nested upside down next to a pile of white drink lids. Flat wooden stirrers fan out of a clear holder.

detailZones.title: Milk and sugar
detailZones.description: A little glass pitcher of milk stands beside the sugar bowl. White sugar cubes are piled above its rim, and a sealed paper packet lies in front.

detailZones.title: Dish towel and countertop
detailZones.description: A striped woven towel lies folded on the pale counter. Several layers and the bound hem can be seen along its near edge.

detailZones.title: Plant and tiled wall
detailZones.description: Climbing stems and variegated leaves rise above a speckled planter. Sunlight from the left casts shadows on the tiled wall.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final photo resolves the brewed coffee, the carafe and brewer, the open bean jar, the grinder, spare filters and serving supplies. Brewing actions and drink preferences are indexed separately.
